## Objective

An approval is consumed exactly once.

## Scope

Outline. To be elaborated when wave 3 becomes current.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Replay and expiry are refused
- [ ] apply and consume are atomic
- [ ] No consequential write happens without a consumed approval
- [ ] The payload applied is the stored canonical payload whose recomputed hash equals the approved hash; a mismatch refuses the apply and is audited (review safeguard RV-06)

Integration tests.
